functions.name: authorize_deed_session_key
functions.doc: Bind or rotate a FunctionCall session public key for an NFT's sub-account (`10-nfts.md`).

functions.name: buy_merchant_item
functions.doc:
Buy a merchant NEP-245 item from the merchant's pre-minted stock.
 Atomically moves `price_respite` RESPITE from the buyer to the
 merchant (master_account) and `amount` of the item from the
 merchant's stock to the buyer, who then holds it in their bag.

 The price is quoted by the client (dynamic stock/demand pricing,
 0.55x-2.15x of base with an investor discount down to ~0.47x), so the
 contract enforces only a floor of 45% of the catalog base price: any
 quote a legitimate client can produce passes, while a forged client
 cannot name a near-zero price for real stock.

functions.name: buy_property
functions.doc:
Buys an escrowed property listing: the buyer's RESPITE moves to
 the seller and the escrowed asset moves to the buyer in this one
 call. Any failed check reverts the whole transaction, so neither
 side can end up paid-but-undelivered or delivered-but-unpaid.

functions.name: cancel_property_listing
functions.doc: Cancels a listing and returns the escrowed asset to the seller.

functions.name: claim_deed_payout
functions.doc:
Claim pending payouts from an NFT's sub-account (`10-nfts.md`).
 Enforces BOTH current `owner_id` AND `expected_key_epoch` so a seller attempting to claim
 mid-transfer or with a stale key is strictly rejected.

functions.name: claim_hana_welcome_near
functions.doc:
One-time onboarding grant distributed directly from Hana's smart contract treasury
 (`0.30 NEAR`) after a new citizen finishes Hana's Central Plaza Cafe tutorial chat.

functions.name: claim_hana_welcome_near_attested
functions.doc:
Google-identity attested starter grant (`0.30 NEAR`): enforces one grant
 per Google email hash AND per NEAR account across wallets via an ed25519
 server attestation matching `/api/hana-claim-attest`.

functions.name: list_property_deed
functions.doc:
Lists a house deed for sale, escrowing the deed NFT with the
 contract until it sells or the listing is cancelled.

functions.name: list_property_furniture
functions.doc:
Lists furniture copies for sale, escrowing the NEP-245 balance
 with the contract until they sell or the listing is cancelled.

functions.name: migrate
functions.doc:
One-time state migration v1.3.0 -> v1.5.0: carries every existing
 field across untouched and optionally installs the fish attester
 public key (hex, 32 bytes) in the same step.

functions.name: migrate_v140_to_v150
functions.doc:
One-time state migration v1.4.0 -> v1.5.0: preserves every live v1.4.0
 balance, deed, fish NFT, listing, and `fish_attester_pubkey`, and
 initializes Hana claim attestation state.

functions.name: mint_fish_nft
functions.doc:
Legacy direct mint — restricted to the master account since
 v1.4.0. Players mint through `mint_fish_nft_attested`, so a fish
 NFT can only come into existence with the game server's signature
 over the catch (see `api/fish-attest`).

functions.name: mint_fish_nft_attested
functions.doc:
Mints a fish NFT for the caller when the game server has attested
 the catch: an ed25519 signature over the canonical message, issued
 at most 10 minutes ago, verified against the configured attester
 public key. The token id is inside the signed message, so an
 attestation cannot be replayed for a different fish.

functions.name: nft_transfer
functions.doc:
Standard NEP-171 `nft_transfer` (`1 yoctoNEAR` required).
 When transferring an Estate / House Deed NFT, control of its tied sub-account ledger,
 accumulated treasury, and pending payouts moves atomically while rotating `key_epoch`
 so the previous owner's FunctionCall session key is immediately invalidated.

functions.name: sell_merchant_item
functions.doc:
Sell a merchant NEP-245 item back to the merchant. Atomically moves
 `amount` of the item from the seller back into the merchant's stock
 and `price_respite` RESPITE from the merchant (master_account) to
 the seller: the buyback is a real on-chain payment, never a cache
 credit.

 The client quotes the buyback at a fixed 65% of the catalog base
 price, so the contract enforces that same figure as a ceiling: any
 quote a legitimate client can produce passes, while a forged client
 cannot drain the merchant by naming an inflated buyback price.

functions.name: set_fish_attester_pubkey
functions.doc:
Master-only: installs or rotates the fish attester public key
 (hex, 32 bytes). The matching private key lives only in the game
 server's environment, never on-chain.

functions.name: set_hana_attester_pubkey
functions.doc:
Master-only: configures or rotates a dedicated ed25519 public key for
 `/api/hana-claim-attest`. When unset, `claim_hana_welcome_near_attested`
 falls back to `fish_attester_pubkey` with strict domain separation.

PropertyListing.description: A property-market listing whose asset is HELD BY THE CONTRACT while listed (true escrow). Deeds move their NFT ownership to the contract account and stash the owner-index record (`house_deeds` is keyed by owner and can hold only one deed per account, so it cannot point at the contract for several escrowed deeds at once) inside the listing; furniture moves its NEP-245 balance to the contract account. Buying settles payment and delivery in this single call — no two-step trust.

amount.description: Copies escrowed: always 1 for deeds, the listed amount for furniture.

deed.description: The escrowed deed's owner-index record (deed listings only).
